raw_variables: electricity use of 111 8th Ave (2022-2024); DC share; heat fraction; recoverable fraction
transformation_formula: Q_rec [MWth] = mean(electricity_avg_MW) x A01 x E01 x E02 ; annual GWh = Q_rec x 8.76
note: Metered whole-building average 14.9-16.9 MW caps supply; pilot used 85 10th Ave as source - 111 8th would be a second source

indicator: Seasonal COP of building heat pumps (source loop -> 45/60 C sink)
raw_variables: loop temperature; sink temperatures; Lorenz efficiency; DEA COP
transformation_formula: COP_h = eta_L x T_lm,sink / (T_lm,sink - T_lm,source) (Kelvin); SCOP = sum(Q_h) / sum(Q_h / COP_h)
note: Calibrate eta_L so the 10 MW excess-heat DEA datasheet COP (4.7) is reproduced at its 25->15 C / 35->70 C design point

raw_variables: same as T2
transformation_formula: = 1 / SCOP
note: Merged into T2 (exact reciprocal)

indicator: Annual demand coverage by recovered heat (hourly-matched)
raw_variables: hourly recoverable heat; hourly offtaker demand; storage
transformation_formula: coverage = sum_h min(Q_rec_h + discharge_h; D_h) / sum_h D_h ; D_h = D_DHW/8760 + D_SH x HDH_h / sum(HDH)
assumptions_used: E10, E17, boiler/steam efficiency to convert fuel to useful heat (see GAP-05)
data_status: partial (hourly shape is a degree-hour model)
note: Hourly shape: TMYx degree-hours for space heat + pilot DHW daily load and 20 h operation (S13); GAP-04 open

raw_variables: T1 annual GWh; anchor heat demand
transformation_formula: ratio = T1_GWh / sum(heat_fuel_MWh_mean of selected offtakers)
note: Upper bound of T4; keep only as sizing check

indicator: Design peak heat demand of selected offtakers
raw_variables: annual heat demand; ASHRAE 99.6% design temperature; HDH distribution
transformation_formula: P_peak = D_DHW/8760 x f_DHW_peak + D_SH x (18 - T_design) / (24 x HDD)
note: Input to sizing and to constraint H2 rather than a score

indicator: Network distance from source to offtaker
raw_variables: lot coordinates
transformation_formula: haversine(site lat/lon; lot lat/lon); trench length ~ 1.3 x straight-line (street grid)
note: Fulton 234 m; Chelsea Market 274 m; Elliott-Chelsea 852 m

indicator: Total CAPEX per kW of delivered heat capacity
raw_variables: heat-pump CAPEX; HRC/chiller CAPEX; storage; pipe; backup
transformation_formula: CAPEX = sum_k capacity_k x unit_cost_k x FX x CPI + pipe_m x c_pipe x A05
assumptions_used: A05 network cost scaling (anchored to pilot 29,318 USD/route-m)
note: DEA = Danish market; EIA = US building-scale units

raw_variables: CAPEX; fixed and variable O&M; electricity price; SCOP; delivered heat; discount rate; life
transformation_formula: LCOH = (CAPEX x CRF + O&M_fix + sum_h(E_el_h x p_el) + O&M_var x Q) / Q ; CRF = r(1+r)^n/((1+r)^n-1)
assumptions_used: A06 fence price, A07 electricity price, A08 discount rate (FEMP 3.0% low case)
note: Core economic indicator

indicator: LCOH relative to the offtaker's current heat cost
raw_variables: C2; baseline steam / gas price; boiler efficiency
transformation_formula: savings % = 1 - LCOH / (p_fuel / eta_boiler) per offtaker; steam baseline needs Con Ed steam tariff
assumptions_used: eta_boiler (EIA S11 0.85); steam baseline = pilot-implied marginal steam cost 139.9 USD/MWh useful (S13)
note: Defines the fence-price headroom for Term 2 (standard heat contract)

raw_variables: C3 x heat volume
transformation_formula: = (baseline cost - LCOH) x Q_delivered
note: Merged: C3 x volume; report in narrative only

raw_variables: C1 and C4
transformation_formula: payback = CAPEX / annual net saving
note: Monotone transform of C2/C3; compare to CBS benchmark E16

raw_variables: UTENJA ownership; DC contract horizon <=10 yr; heat-transfer between properties
transformation_formula: Rubric 0-2: 0 = no legal owner/route; 1 = route exists but untested; 2 = route used in NY precedent
note: Folded into S5 to avoid double-scoring governance

raw_variables: heat delivered to offtakers; DC IT energy
transformation_formula: ERF = Q_reused / E_IT ; E_IT = electricity_MWh x A01 / PUE (E20)
note: Benchmarks: EU average 15% (E23); Germany 10-20% (E24)

raw_variables: displaced steam / gas / oil; added HP electricity; LL97 factors
transformation_formula: dCO2 = sum_f(displaced_fuel_f x EF_f) - E_el_HP x EF_el
data_status: ready (2024-29 factors); post-2030 grid factor is a gap (GAP-06)

raw_variables: same as N2
transformation_formula: = (E_el_HP x EF_el) / Q_delivered
note: Merged into N2 (same numerator)

indicator: On-site combustion displaced next to the EJ block
raw_variables: gas/oil burned in offtaker buildings; displaced share; local boiler emission density
transformation_formula: combustion_displaced = sum(gas+oil MWh x displaced share) ; context = UHF42 boiler NOx 123.9 t/km2 vs NYC 20.8
assumptions_used: Steam is burned off-site, so it does not count here
note: Converting to t NOx/PM needs EPA AP-42 factors (GAP-09; optional)

raw_variables: heat diverted from towers; evaporation share
transformation_formula: W = Q_diverted [MWh] x 3600 / h_fg(2.43 MJ/kg) / 1000 [m3] (evaporation only; blowdown scales with it)
assumptions_used: Only if tenant towers are evaporative (GAP-10)
note: Do not claim until tower type is confirmed

indicator: Winter grid peak avoided vs all-electric ASHP alternative
raw_variables: design-hour heat demand; ASHP COP at design temp; loop HP COP; Zone J winter peak
transformation_formula: dP = P_peak_heat x (1/COP_ASHP(T_design) - 1/COP_loop) ; context share = dP / Zone J winter peak (7552 MW in 2025)
assumptions_used: ASHP COP at -10.5 C is not in the downloaded data (GAP-11)
note: Con Ed pilot found 10-15% MORE electricity than ASHP on peak days (S13): the peak benefit is not automatic - report honestly

raw_variables: apartments, residents, fixed-income share of connected NYCHA developments
transformation_formula: HH_served = sum(apartments of connected developments) ; weighted by DAC flag
note: Fulton 944 apts / 1,809 residents / 50% fixed income; tract 36061008300 is a designated DAC

indicator: Heating cost per apartment vs baseline
raw_variables: C3 per NYCHA apartment
transformation_formula: = (baseline - tariff) x heat per apartment
note: Same quantity as C3; keep for the narrative only

indicator: Environmental-justice exposure of the served block
raw_variables: DAC designation and percentile; PM2.5 and NO2 vs city; site-pack percentiles
csv_columns: dac_designation, percentile_rank_combined, lmi_80_ami; Fine particles annual mean (UHF42 9.5 vs NYC 6.3)
transformation_formula: EJ = DAC flag x percentile_rank_combined ; PM ratio = PM2.5_UHF42 / PM2.5_NYC
note: Tract 36061008300: DAC; combined percentile 0.84; LMI 80% AMI = 80%

raw_variables: HVI by ZCTA
transformation_formula: HVI of the served ZCTA (1-5)
note: ZIP 10011 = 1 (lowest); ZIP-level masks the NYCHA block - low discriminating power

raw_variables: community process; precedents; ownership route; DC contract horizon
transformation_formula: Rubric 0-4 scored by the team from documented evidence
note: Absorbs C6

indicator: Design-window fit with the Fulton/Elliott-Chelsea rebuild
raw_variables: rebuild phasing and schedule; heat-ready design
transformation_formula: Rubric 0-2: aligns heat-ready design with rebuild phases
note: Key to the innovation story; keep as a qualitative criterion

indicator: DC cooling never depends on the network (bypass to existing towers)
raw_variables: design rule
transformation_formula: binary: must be TRUE

indicator: Backup capacity >= design peak of every connected offtaker
raw_variables: T6 and backup capacity
transformation_formula: P_backup >= P_peak (T6)
note: Reflects Verizon's 'not solely rely' condition (R04)

raw_variables: T1
transformation_formula: sum(Q_delivered) <= T1 annual and hourly

raw_variables: HP sink temperature
transformation_formula: T_sink_DHW >= 60 C
note: Code requirement; verify NYC code reference

raw_variables: simulation outputs
transformation_formula: |supply - demand - losses - storage change| < 1e-6
note: Already implemented in the model graph checks

indicator: Net annual value to the data center (heat sales + own-heat displacement - added electricity/O&M)
raw_variables: heat sold; fence price; added electricity; added O&M; 111 8th own steam/gas displaced; LL97 factors
csv_columns: heat_purchase_price_paid_to_source, source_thermal_revenues_yr1, source_incremental_electricity_cost_yr1; steam_MWh, gas_MWh; tCO2e_per_MWh
transformation_formula: V_DC = Q_sold x p_fence - dE_el x p_el - dO&M + (own steam+gas displaced x price) ; dCO2_own = displaced fuel x LL97 factor
note: Brief requires value for DC, users and community separately; S2/C3 cover users, N4/S3 community
